combination_rule: Only listed complete and adjudicated recipes can compile; do not form Cartesian product of enums. null in recipe is unresolved, never provider omission permission.

event_mapping.rule: Never auto-map to OTHER/custom_event_str or fabricate custom conversion.

measurement_contract.authority: VOLC proposed contract; Meta fields individually sourced

capi.action_source: Use actual approved origin; P0CAPI none, first web contract literalwebsite; other enum recipes research first.

dedup.event_id: Generated once by business occurrence owner, persisted and reused through retries; not random on each ingestion.
dedup.identity: Same event_name + event_id + Pixel/source for same occurrence, across Pixel and server
dedup.window: Official browser/server rule48h; do not generalize to all ingestion paths or guaranteed exactly-once

diagnostics.fields: events_received/messages/trace if officially available; event match quality and dedup diagnostics require separately verified API/UI evidence source
diagnostics.minimum_proof: One consented test occurrence with provider Test Events receipt, matching browser/server identity and diagnostics, no campaign activation.

capi.entry: Proposed backend event ingestion -> durable minimized outbox -> provider transport; existing CAPI legacy remains isolated until authorized migration
capi.event_name: Versioned case-sensitive catalog; reject unknown, never default ViewContent.
capi.event_source_url: Website required; authorized verified domain and exact public URL; strip secrets/PII only through approved source normalization before event generation.
capi.event_time: UTC integerseconds from occurrence; source META-CAPI-EVENT allows<=7days; future time beyond validated clock allowance quarantined; do not rewrite occurrence to send time.

privacy.audit: Only refs/hashes/classification/times and minimized provider errors; no user_data or token in advertising ledger/browser.
privacy.consent: Timestamped policy version/state; revoked or absent blocks collection/dispatch as applicable.
privacy.data_minimization: Do not send sensitive categories or URL/query PII. Hashing is pseudonymization, not anonymization.
privacy.disable: Per source capability off stops new delivery; quarantine pending; retain legally required minimal audit; purge governed separately.
privacy.legal_basis: Explicit controller-approved basis/purpose and processing contract; LGPD adjudication by responsible privacy owner, not inferred consent from token or checkbox.
privacy.retention: Proposed raw data memory only; encrypted outbox <=7days then minimized receipt; final numeric audit retention requires policy approval before enabling.

capi.test_event: Use provider-supported test_event_code only after field/endpoint verification; test vs production separate credentials capability/source/environment/outbox. It is a backend-only parameter, never campaign optimizer input.
capi.transport: Persist occurrence before send; classify acceptance/refusal/ambiguous; safe retry preserves event identity. Batch old/invalid events quarantined individually before sending, not reset event_time.

user_data.missing: Do not invent match identifiers; do not fingerprint to fill gaps.
user_data.normalization: Field-specific official normalization before SHA256; no generic stringify/hash; exact normalization fixtures required before enabling.

capi.version: Current v21 implementation not automatically unsupported; upgrade/test per Graph lifecycle, not Marketing table. No dualsend migration without stable event identity.

custom_conversion_create.approval: Separate administrative act; no campaign creation implicit; no same-name dedup alone
custom_conversion_create.disable: Local selection eligibility off, stop CAPI delivery only if separately authorized; no automatic delete/archive
custom_conversion_create.provider_fields: Resolve only fields verified in META-CUSTOM; exact rule DSL and create edge recipe remain blocked by C10.
custom_conversion_create.readback: Scoped identity/rule/source/availability; received object may be unavailable/never fired

discovery.event_catalog: No generic list-all-events endpoint assumed. Resolve verified official discovery capability or backend registry + human provider diagnostic evidence. No invented event if unavailable.

adspixels.identity: retain provider object kind; Dataset alias only with evidence

customconversions.desired: persist scoped source/rule availability and observation

measurement_contract.optimization: Compiler receives existing source/event/custom-conversion refs, never creates measurement resources as helper.
measurement_contract.revenue: Keep internal order ledger and provider attribution facts separate; reconcile comparable windows/timezone/currency and lineage where legally permitted; mark unmatched and modelled, do not force equality.
